scope: Saved synthetic California-first coverage implementation and coordinator browser evidence; no hosted rollout

source_artifacts.text:
name: Verify

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: verify-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  native-postgres:
    name: Native PostgreSQL worksheet and tenant regression
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: m63_test_admin
          POSTGRES_DB: m63_integration
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 55463:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U m63_test_admin -d m63_integration"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Initialize and challenge isolated PostgreSQL roles and storage
        run: bun test packages/neuvetra-database/src/hosted.test.ts
        env:
          M63_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
      - name: Verify staged HTTP and frontend decoding against PostgreSQL
        run: bun test apps/site-api/src/staging/postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m67-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m68-postgres.test.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m71-postgres.test.ts
        env:
          M63_API_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration
          M71_API_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m63_integration

  applications:
    name: Typecheck, lint, unit tests and web builds
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run check
      - name: Independent source-linked worksheet decoder and report cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m66-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m66-independent-renderer.test.ts
      - name: Independent annual worksheet decoder, renderer and print-action cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-renderer.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m67-independent-print-view.test.ts
      - name: Independent annual evidence decoder, UI, print-action and packaging cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-print-view.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m68-independent-ui.test.ts
      - name: Independent corporate coverage validation, decoder and actor-lifetime cases
        run: bun test evaluations/research-qa/m71-qa-validation.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m71-qa-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m71-qa-ui.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m71-security-frontend.test.ts evaluations/research-qa/m71-security-parser.test.ts
      - name: Offline cloud database boundary tests
        run: bun test tools/cloud/database-inventory.test.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.test.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.test.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.test.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.test.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.test.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.test.ts tools/research/cloud-fetch-injection.test.ts
      - name: Typecheck cloud database helper
        run: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --types bun --strict --skipLibCheck tools/cloud/database-inventory.ts tools/cloud/database-inventory.test.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.ts tools/cloud/apply-development.test.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.ts tools/cloud/data-api-exposure.test.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.ts tools/cloud/activate-synthetic.test.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.ts tools/cloud/website-publication.test.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.ts tools/cloud/check-website-reader.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-cloud.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-composed.test.ts tools/research/evaluate-website-questions.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.ts tools/research/cloud-read-diagnostics.test.ts tools/research/cloud-fetch-injection.test.ts

  staging-image:
    name: Dedicated staging image and offline runtime smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build explicit combined image without provider credentials
        run: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --file Dockerfile.staging --tag neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} .
      - name: Verify runtime imports, pinned assets, Python and actual HTTP listener offline
        run: |
          docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint bun neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} -e '
            import {createStagingServer} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts";
            import {readStagingConfig,STAGING_PROFILE} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/staging/config.ts";
            import {runEngine} from "/app/apps/site-api/src/calculation/server.ts";
            const {readMigrationManifest}=await import("/app/packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-migrations.ts");
            const manifest=await readMigrationManifest();if(manifest.length!==15||manifest[14].name!=="0015_corporate_coverage.sql")throw new Error("Incomplete image migration manifest");
            const ref="abcdefghijklmnopqrst";
            const config=readStagingConfig({NODE_ENV:"test",NEUVETRA_STAGING_ENABLED:"enabled",NEUVETRA_STAGING_PROFILE:STAGING_PROFILE,NEUVETRA_STAGING_PROJECT_REF:ref,NEUVETRA_STAGING_ORIGIN:"http://127.0.0.1:8080",SUPABASE_URL:`https://${ref}.supabase.co`,SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:"sb_publishable_synthetic_fixture_not_a_real_key",DATABASE_URL:`postgres://neuvetra_runtime:fixture@db.${ref}.supabase.co:5432/postgres`});
            const database={checkReadiness:async()=>({profile:STAGING_PROFILE,schemaVersion:15}),close:async()=>{}};
            const app=await createStagingServer(config,{database,validateUser:async()=>null,log:()=>{}});
            const server=Bun.serve({hostname:"127.0.0.1",port:8080,fetch:app.fetch});
            try {
              for(const route of ["/health","/ready","/","/workspace-api/config"]) {const r=await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${route}`);if(r.status!==200||r.headers.get("cache-control")!=="no-store")throw new Error("Image HTTP smoke failed");await r.arrayBuffer();}
              const index=await (await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8080/")).text();
              const scripts=[...index.matchAll(/src="([^"]+\.js)"/g)].map(m=>m[1]);
              if(scripts.length===0)throw new Error("No built staging application");
              for(const src of scripts){if(!src.startsWith("/assets/"))throw new Error("External application script");const r=await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${src}`);if(r.status!==200)throw new Error("Missing staged bundle");await r.arrayBuffer();}
              for(const route of ["/.env","/apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts","/tools/research/m43-heldout-first-batch-v1.json"])if((await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:8080${route}`)).status!==404)throw new Error("Non-public path exposed");
              if((await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8080/workspace-api/session")).status!==401)throw new Error("Authentication boundary failed");
              const uuid="11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
              const binding={company_id:uuid,evidence_id:uuid,bill_version_id:uuid,activity_version_id:uuid,facility_id:uuid,boundary_id:uuid,bill_version:2,activity_version:1,extraction_id:uuid,parser_version:"m55-fixed-pdf-v1",previous_bill_version_id:uuid,evidence_sha256:"0a97cd0976c03af0776214fc19bdc3d4f0c00e9c835f3e116574a6f375c8e135",source_quantity_kwh:"12346.000",normalized_quantity_mwh:"12.346000",correction_reason:"Synthetic review exercise",service_period:{start:"2023-01-01",end:"2023-01-31"},facility:{name:"Synthetic California office",country:"United States",state:"California",egrid_subregion:"CAMX"},boundary:{reporting_year:2023,approach:"operational_control",status:"draft",version:1}};
              const calculation=await runEngine({action:"calculate_linked_bill",binding});
              if(calculation.status!=="ok"||calculation.record?.total?.unrounded!=="2407.9674055248")throw new Error("Container Decimal calculation failed");
              console.info(JSON.stringify({imageSmoke:"passed",database:"injected_offline",authentication:"refusal_only",calculation:"real_python",assets:"hash_verified"}));
            } finally {await server.stop(true);await app.close();}
          '
      - name: Refuse ordinary container startup without explicit staging configuration
        run: |
          if docker run --rm --network none neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }}; then
            echo "Container unexpectedly started without staging configuration"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Record exact local image identity
        run: docker image inspect neuvetra-m63:${{ github.sha }} --format '{{.Id}}'

  research-catalog:
    name: Offline research catalog tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: python -m unittest discover -s tools/research -p "test_*.py" -v
      - name: Offline cloud evidence boundary tests
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tools/cloud -p "test_*.py" -v

  ghg-calculations:
    name: GHG calculation specifications and engine
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.12
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check pint==0.26 pytest==9.1.1 pyyaml==6.0.3
      - run: bun run test:ghg

# Dedicated combined M63 image. Build from the repository root with this file;
# Dockerfile.staging.dockerignore is the matching deny-by-default context filter.
# This does not alter the ordinary Site/FrontDesk Dockerfiles or enable flags.
FROM oven/bun:1.3.12 AS workspace
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json bun.lock ./
COPY apps/frontdesk-api/package.json ./apps/frontdesk-api/
COPY apps/frontdesk-web/package.json ./apps/frontdesk-web/
COPY apps/site-api/package.json ./apps/site-api/
COPY apps/site-web/package.json ./apps/site-web/
COPY apps/terrascope-api/package.json ./apps/terrascope-api/
COPY apps/terrascope-web/package.json ./apps/terrascope-web/
COPY packages/frontdesk-config/package.json ./packages/frontdesk-config/
COPY packages/frontdesk-database/package.json ./packages/frontdesk-database/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/package.json ./packages/neuvetra-database/
COPY packages/terrascope-config/package.json ./packages/terrascope-config/
COPY packages/terrascope-database/package.json ./packages/terrascope-database/
COPY packages/terrascope-calculator/package.json ./packages/terrascope-calculator/

FROM workspace AS web-build
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --filter site-web
COPY tsconfig.base.json ./
COPY config/typescript/ ./config/typescript/
COPY apps/site-web/tsconfig.json apps/site-web/tsconfig.app.json apps/site-web/tsconfig.node.json apps/site-web/vite.config.ts apps/site-web/vite.staging.config.ts apps/site-web/staging.html ./apps/site-web/
COPY apps/site-web/scripts/finalize-staging.ts ./apps/site-web/scripts/
COPY apps/site-web/src/ ./apps/site-web/src/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/m64-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-fixtures.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-template.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/m71-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m71-validation.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
# Full web typechecking resolves this reviewed catalog; it is not a runtime corpus.
COPY data/research/answer-units/scope2-website.epa-acquisition.v1.json ./data/research/answer-units/
COPY output/pdf/neuvetra-m55-synthetic-electricity-bill.pdf output/pdf/neuvetra-m66-synthetic-electricity-bill-b.pdf ./output/pdf/
RUN bun run --filter site-web build:staging

FROM workspace AS production-dependencies
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --production --filter site-api

FROM python:3.12.11-slim-bookworm AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production \
    PORT=8080 \
    NEUVETRA_PYTHON=/usr/local/bin/python \
    NEUVETRA_STAGING_WEB_ROOT=/app/apps/site-web/dist-staging \
    NEUVETRA_STAGING_DB_CA_FILE=/app/tools/cloud/fixtures/supabase-prod-ca-2021.crt \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
COPY --from=workspace /usr/local/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bun
COPY --from=production-dependencies /app/ ./
COPY tsconfig.base.json ./
COPY config/typescript/ ./config/typescript/
COPY apps/site-api/tsconfig.json ./apps/site-api/
COPY apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts apps/site-api/src/staging/config.ts apps/site-api/src/staging/assets.ts ./apps/site-api/src/staging/
COPY apps/site-api/src/workspace/service.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/types.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/synthetic-bill-parser.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m64-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m65-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-source-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m66-report-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m67-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m67-report-routes.ts ./apps/site-api/src/workspace/

COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/index.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/workspace.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/hosted.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-migrations.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-audit.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/staging-tls.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m58.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m59.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m60.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m61.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m64.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m64-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m65-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m66-fixtures.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m67-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-template.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
COPY packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-contract.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-template.ts packages/neuvetra-database/src/m68-report.ts ./packages/neuvetra-database/src/
COPY apps/site-api/src/workspace/m68-routes.ts apps/site-api/src/workspace/m68-report-routes.ts ./apps/site-api/src/workspace/
COPY apps/site-api/src/workspace/m71-routes.ts ./apps/site-api/src/workspace/

COPY output/pdf/neuvetra-m55-synthetic-electricity-bill.pdf output/pdf/neuvetra-m66-synthetic-electricity-bill-b.pdf ./output/pdf/
COPY data/synthetic/m58-electricity-register-2023.json data/synthetic/m58-electricity-register-2023.manifest.json ./data/synthetic/
COPY tools/cloud/fixtures/supabase-prod-ca-2021.crt ./tools/cloud/fixtures/
COPY --from=web-build /app/apps/site-web/dist-staging/ ./apps/site-web/dist-staging/
# Import and hash verification happen without credentials or network calls.
RUN bun --version && python --version && bun -e 'await import("./apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts"); const {verifyStagingAssets}=await import("./apps/site-api/src/staging/assets.ts"); await verifyStagingAssets("/app/apps/site-web/dist-staging");'
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=20s --start-period=30s --retries=3 CMD ["bun", "-e", "const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+(process.env.PORT||'8080')+'/ready',{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(18000)});process.exit(r.ok?0:1)"]
CMD ["bun", "run", "apps/site-api/src/staging/server.ts"]

# M71 — saved California corporate coverage register

## Board outcome

Following accepted M70 feedback, make the California-first coverage workflow real in the existing private synthetic application. The board prioritizes California reporting and clarified that operations elsewhere should be included when logically necessary to the company boundary. Separate Nevada, Canada and other regulatory products remain deferred. Use a California-only, stable operational-control office/distribution group for calendar 2025. Preserve discovered out-of-profile operations as unresolved gaps; no complete-inventory claim follows from a supported subset.

## Scope and acceptance

Save and reload a versioned corporate entity/facility/source universe, Scope 1/2 screening and all 15 Scope 3 category screenings. Keep disposition, activity, evidence, method and review states distinct. Validate evidence references, rationale, missing/zero and unsupported conditions. Corrections append immutable versions with stale-head and idempotency controls. A different manager who did not contribute to the saved version can record a bounded internal review. Download the exact selected version's coverage JSON, preserving gaps and history.

Implement the accepted M70 architecture's COV01–07 and COV12 plus applicable synthetic COV08–09 checks through the real local PostgreSQL driver, API and browser. No new emissions methods, corporate totals, legal applicability decisions, arbitrary customer uploads or assurance package. Additive schema migration must preserve M63–M68 records and pass restart/restore and tenant isolation tests. Existing hosted changes, if needed, follow a concrete reviewed migration/backup plan and fresh runtime checks.

## Ownership and delivery

- `/root/m71_backend`: database/schema/API/contracts and relevant native tests; data/database role with CTO responsibility. Requested Astra/high; observed unknown.
- `/root`: frontend integration, operating records, safe local runtime, publication and demonstration.
- `/root/m70_research`: independent security review, reused non-author context after fresh security dispatch hit runtime thread limit; inherited compute unknown.
- `/root/m70_cpo`: M71 acceptance/independent implementation QA, with prior M70 requirement authorship disclosed; no M71 code authorship. Inherited compute unknown.

One writer per implementation path. Root alone publishes to codex/corporate-mvp / draft PR5. Independent review, exact-byte checks and remote required checks precede completion. Demonstrate the saved California workflow and collect board feedback before dependent methods/evidence expansion. No new branch, service subscription, paid AI run or source/method release.

# M71 saved synthetic corporate coverage contract

Implementation handoff, M71-BACKEND. Requested Astra/high; observed settings unknown. Source of truth for browser-safe types and seed: `packages/neuvetra-database/src/m71-contract.ts`. Canonical snapshots are the bounded implementation of M70's proposed normalized tables. Version identity versions every contained record; stable record IDs never disappear. General evidence uploads, released methods, calculations and legal determination remain outside this increment.

## HTTP and browser integration

All paths begin `/workspace/{companyId}/corporate-inventories` inside the existing `/workspace-api` staging prefix. Existing bearer/origin rules apply.

- GET collection returns `M71Register` (empty versions/head/inventory null before creation).
- POST collection accepts `M71SaveInput` with null expected version/hash and correction reason; returns the exact created `M71Version`.
- GET `/{inventoryId}` returns `M71Register`.
- GET `/{inventoryId}/versions/{versionId}` returns exact `M71Version`.
- POST `/{inventoryId}/versions` accepts `M71SaveInput` with current expected version/hash and nonempty correction reason; returns exact created version, including idempotent replay of an older request.
- POST `/{inventoryId}/reviews` accepts `M71ReviewInput`; returns exact `M71Review`.
- GET `/{inventoryId}/versions/{versionId}/coverage-export` downloads canonical UTF-8 JSON for that version **with review null**, frozen at save. Later reviews are returned separately by version/register reads; they cannot alter original export bytes.

All mutation inputs reject additional fields and duplicate JSON keys. Labels/reasons normalize trimmed Unicode NFC; text limits count Unicode characters. Set arrays sort by stable ID; evidence purposes and missing facts sort by Unicode code point, matching PostgreSQL C collation. API returns 422 for invalid/no-op, 409 for stale head/key conflict/review conflict, 403 for members attempting writes, 404 for inaccessible tenant/object, and bounded 503 for failed integrity. Reads have no-store. Only current owner/admin managers write; only a manager absent from the accumulated contributor set can review. Label-only, screening-reason-only, evidence-only and correction-reason-only successors are meaningful; no-op compares both the complete normalized snapshot and correction reason.

The bounded synthetic profile permits 40 versions, 50,000 UTF-8 bytes per normalized snapshot and 3,800,000 total frozen export bytes. The remaining 200,000 bytes of the 4 MB response budget cover the limited review records and envelope. A capacity refusal occurs before history/head mutation and leaves existing read/export access intact. API 422 codes distinguish `history_limit` and `history_bytes_limit`. These are demonstration bounds; production history pagination and customer retention policies remain future work.

Per current board direction, the seed includes only California parent/distribution operations, two facilities/electricity sources, the expected control relationship, full effective intervals, boundary decisions, all 25 required group screenings and two source detail rows. California-first reporting does not authorize omitting operations elsewhere: discoveries remain in the corporate boundary with visible geography/method gaps. Recording them does not launch another jurisdiction's regulatory product. Managers can edit typed snapshot fields and add discoveries; supported profile gaps become findings. Existing entity/relationship/facility/source/coverage/requirement IDs cannot be dropped or repurposed. Entity decision intervals must cover every active interval without overlap. Missing data is null; explicit zero requires quantity, unit, reason and supporting evidence. All methods stay not-assessed/unsupported/candidate; no released method value is accepted.

Synthetic evidence references may only resolve to the pinned `M71_ARTIFACT` ID/hash/locator for 2025. Linking proves the fixture reference, not evidence sufficiency. Exclusion/non-applicability requires a rationale and supporting reference at submission; even accepted assertions remain open, unverified findings. Proposed estimates additionally require a method candidate, assumptions, input references and uncertainty. Requirement rows permit only unknown/conflicting applicability and carry missing facts. Derived completeness is always incomplete, release eligibility false, emissions null and assurance none.

## Persistence and recovery

Additive migration 0015 follows observed schema 14. Its reviewed candidate SHA-256 is `2766561decde3ea64bf56f30b1b67a9144318e14b6efecaa71e05e8ae6351d19`. Immutable version/review/request/audit records, mutable tenant head, forced RLS and runtime SELECT/approved function execution only. Writers lock admission then membership then company/head; recheck permission; resolve prior idempotency outcome; compare expected head; retain accumulated contributors and immutable predecessor; atomically save audit/request/head. No startup migration or rewrite of prior receipts. Deployment/backup/restore is coordinator-owned; rollback after writes means restore a verified schema-14 backup and matching prior application, preserving an export of M71 records first. Do not down-migrate destructively in place.

The version content hash covers the normalized snapshot; the version hash additionally binds tenant/inventory/version/predecessor, creator, captured time, contributors and correction reason. SQL freezes canonical export text at save. Readback recomputes the bundled synthetic artifact text hash against its pin and independently checks normalized snapshot semantics, derived findings against retained export bytes, native columns, predecessor/contributor lineage, hashes, exactly one matching audit and exactly one reconstructed operation fingerprint per saved version/review. Idempotent save responses retain review null, so later review does not change the original response/export. Current exact-version reads expose later review separately.

`apps/site-api/src/workspace/m71-postgres.test.ts` passed on the final schema-14 clone upgraded to schema 15: one integrated native PostgreSQL/API/frontend-decoder test, 3,910 assertions in the latest run (the preserved-row checks vary with the fixture baseline). Positive authorized SQL rollback controls accompany strict-type negative cases, including partial group screenings and null review decisions. Unicode private-use/astral ordering and a 300-emoji correction reason survive the actual driver/API/browser decoder. A real 40-version history reaches the count limit; version 41 is refused while current reads, old exports and original idempotent replay remain available. Test rollback probes abort even if a rejected case unexpectedly succeeds.

Reproduction uses the dedicated loopback fixture and `M71_API_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://m63_test_admin@127.0.0.1:55463/m71_author_release`; CI's existing isolated `/m63_integration` target is also explicitly accepted. No provider credentials or customer input are required. Author API and database typechecks passed. The independent QA and security owners retain their original failures, repair checks and final exact-candidate verdicts in `evaluations/research-qa/m71-qa-review.md` and `m71-security-review.md`. # M71 operating boundaries

M71 is a saved **synthetic coverage register**, integrated into the existing private application. California reporting is the first product focus. A company's relevant operations elsewhere can be recorded and remain visible when methods, control facts or evidence are unsupported. This does not implement another jurisdiction's reporting product.

## Persistence and review

The server derives the acting user from authentication and checks current workspace admission and membership inside the database transaction. Saved corrections append versions; earlier contributors cannot review a successor. Review is bounded internal acceptance or a request for changes. It never establishes complete coverage, released methods, legal applicability or external assurance.

The coverage export is retained at save. Later review decisions are shown separately and do not alter the earlier download. Readback checks the snapshot, hashes, lineage, native columns, request provenance, audit and retained export bytes. Failed integrity checks withhold the register.

The fictional demonstration has bounded storage: at most 40 versions, 50,000 UTF-8 bytes per canonical snapshot and 3,800,000 total retained export bytes, with response space reserved for reviews and the envelope. A capacity refusal leaves earlier versions available. These are demonstration limits, not a customer-scale storage design.

## Local verification

Use isolated loopback PostgreSQL fixtures, an exact verified schema-14 baseline and canonical migration 0015. Preserve earlier fixtures when migration bytes change; never rewrite their receipts. Independent reviewers test native API behavior, tenant and revocation boundaries, corruption refusal and restoration. Browser verification uses the real register component and PostgreSQL-backed staging server with explicitly labeled fictional actors. It does not establish hosted authentication or deployment.

The temporary preview entry point and actor selector live outside published application outputs. The dedicated production image has an explicit source/migration allowlist; the local selector is excluded. Existing M63–M68 screens remain part of the private application.

## Existing-host deployment gate

Publishing reviewed code to rolling draft PR5 does not change the running service or hosted database. Before a hosted rollout:

1. Recheck the actual existing Railway service, source branch/head, successful deployment and Supabase project identity. Historical observations are not current proof.
2. Verify all 14 hosted migration receipts against the canonical manifest, inventory existing rows/roles and create a private recoverable backup. Verify recovery without altering the live baseline.
3. Apply only the reviewed additive 0015 migration through the existing operator connection with TLS verification. Preserve a durable migration receipt and old-row checks. Do not load the unrelated ENV export.
4. Build and deploy the exact reviewed rolling-PR head on the existing service, with schema-15 readiness and the same private authentication boundary. Check signed-out refusal and signed-in synthetic save, correction, distinct review and earlier export.
5. If deployment fails, retain all data and use the verified compatible prior image where possible. Do not drop the new tables or overwrite migration receipts as a rollback shortcut.

No M71 hosted rollout is established by the local tests or by this plan. No paid model request, new provider, customer upload, source release or calculation method is part of this milestone.
